candidate_selection: Per query: two unique displayed geomorphon candidates, two unique displayed TinyMorph candidates, and site-stratified random controls until five exact windows. Shared candidates are selected once; random sites prefer sites not yet present. No expert label was used for selection.
display: Each pair uses 64x64 preview from native DEM comparison grids, same horizontal metres and common pair-relative elevation limits, gray hillshade with 8x vertical display exaggeration. Images are not surface photographs.
rating: At least two independent geoscience/remote-sensing reviewers rate morphology 0-3/U before seeing Earth geology; then separately rate material and mission 0-3/U when independent evidence permits. Store per-reviewer JSON without sending it to the server.
answer_key_policy: Private answer key contains candidate site, exact gallery row, selection arm and displayed top-five positions; never place under web/public or web/dist.
limitations: All reference and Earth sites were available during method design; this is not a new geographic holdout or prospective discovery benchmark.
The eight Earth sites are roughly 3 km crops with overlapping windows; 120 pairs do not represent 120 independent landforms.
A random gallery control is not a verified negative analog. Top-five results outside the judged pool remain unjudged.
Published geologic maps are cartographic polygons, not observed rock exposure or per-window mineral truth; Moon/Mars matching material data remain incomplete.
No independent ratings exist at freeze time; do not report model superiority, global Recall@5, or a new valid analog discovery from this pack alone.
